note: Skinned additions for derived bodies: the build_additions shape builder and its params, how the addition follows the skeleton (chain: rigid or length gradient with tip shares), the rings the deformation check exempts from C2 (sunk or flared into the body by design) and the joint it must stay behind (C5, or null). SPEC Track R. look: what the in-game checklist tells the tester to look for.

tail.look: a horse tail from the back of the hips: a tufted, flared base over the tunic hem, a plume curving down and back, a split (tufted) tip

tuft.look: a short tied tuft coming out back and down from the back of the head or helmet

ears.look: two horse ears on the sides of the crown (pointed, cupped forward)
